title: Modern Treasury testimonial carousel
description: One customer story at a time in a wide pale-blush card: a bold wordmark on the left, the quote with a hanging open-quote, the person's name and role, and a small solid ink button on the right. Two round ink arrow buttons above the card's top-right corner step through the stories. Stacked and centred-logo on phones.
notes: arrows need JavaScript; without it the first story shows
the wordmark is text (or a logo node) in place of the customer's logo image
